notes.title: Update 1.1 is Live
notes.notes:
Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added full controller support
[*] The list of messages on the phone now supports scrolling
[*] New main menu screen
[*] New, more detailed tree meshes
[*] Lighting improvements
[*] Foliage improvements
[*] Menu and user interface improvements
[*] Fixed bug: Enemy can't be defeated in some cases
[*] Some other smaller fixes and improvements
[/list]
